import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators InnerProductSpace

theorem prescribed_pair_exact_support
  (n : ℕ)
  (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
  (i j : Fin n)
  (hij : i ≠ j)
  (hxi : x i ≠ 0)
  (hxj : x j ≠ 0) :
  ∃ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
    ‖y‖ = 1 ∧
    ⟪x, y⟫_ℝ = 0 ∧
    {k : Fin n | y k ≠ 0} = ({i, j} : Set (Fin n)) ∧
    y i ≠ 0 ∧
    y j ≠ 0 := by
  classical
  let z := EuclideanSpace.single i (x j) - EuclideanSpace.single j (x i)
  have hji : j ≠ i := Ne.symm hij
  
  have hz_i : z i = x j := by
    simp [z, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hij, hji]
  
  have hz_j : z j = -x i := by
    simp [z, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hij, hji]
  
  have hz : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hzero_j := congrArg (fun v => v j) hzero
    have : x i = 0 := by
      simpa [hz_j] using hzero_j
    exact hxi this
  
  have hnormz : ‖z‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz
  
  let y := (‖z‖ : ℝ)⁻¹ • z
  
  have hnorm : ‖y‖ = 1 := by
    simpa [y] using (norm_smul_inv_norm hz)
  
  have horthz : ⟪x, z⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
    simp [z, inner_sub_right, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, mul_comm]
  
  have horth : ⟪x, y⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
    change ⟪x, (‖z‖ : ℝ)⁻¹ • z⟫_ℝ = 0
    rw [real_inner_smul_right, horthz, mul_zero]
  
  have hy_i : y i ≠ 0 := by
    simp [y, hz_i, hnormz, hxj]
  
  have hy_j : y j ≠ 0 := by
    simp [y, hz_j, hnormz, hxi]
  
  have hsupport :
      {k : Fin n | y k ≠ 0} = ({i, j} : Set (Fin n)) := by
    ext k
    constructor
    · intro hk
      change y k ≠ 0 at hk
      by_cases hki : k = i
      · simp [hki]
      · by_cases hkj : k = j
        · simp [hkj]
        · have hyzero : y k = 0 := by
            simp [y, z, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hki, hkj]
          exact False.elim (hk hyzero)
    · intro hk
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hk
      rcases hk with rfl | rfl
      · exact hy_i
      · exact hy_j
  
  exact ⟨y, hnorm, horth, hsupport, hy_i, hy_j⟩

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators InnerProductSpace

theorem prescribed_pair_exact_support
  (n : ℕ)
  (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
  (i j : Fin n)
  (hij : i ≠ j)
  (hxi : x i ≠ 0)
  (hxj : x j ≠ 0) :
  ∃ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
    ‖y‖ = 1 ∧
    ⟪x, y⟫_ℝ = 0 ∧
    {k : Fin n | y k ≠ 0} = ({i, j} : Set (Fin n)) ∧
    y i ≠ 0 ∧
    y j ≠ 0 := by
  let a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) := EuclideanSpace.single i (x j)
  let b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) := EuclideanSpace.single j (x i)
  let w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) := a - b
  
  have hwi : w i = x j := by
    simp [w, a, b, hij]
  
  have hwj : w j = -x i := by
    simp [w, a, b, hij]
  
  have hwn : w ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hh : w i = 0 := by
      rw [h]
      rfl
    exact hxj (by simpa [hwi] using hh)
  
  let y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) := ‖w‖⁻¹ • w
  
  have hnorm : ‖y‖ = 1 := by
    dsimp [y]
    rw [norm_smul, norm_inv]
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg w)] using
      (inv_mul_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hwn))
  
  have hinner : ⟪x, w⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
    dsimp [w, a, b]
    rw [inner_sub_right, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right,
      EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
    simp only [conj_trivial]
    ring
  
  have hyinner : ⟪x, y⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
    dsimp [y]
    rw [inner_smul_right, hinner]
    simp
  
  have hyi : y i ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [y]
    rw [hwi]
    exact
      mul_ne_zero
        (inv_ne_zero (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hwn))
        hxj
  
  have hyj : y j ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [y]
    rw [hwj]
    exact
      mul_ne_zero
        (inv_ne_zero (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hwn))
        (neg_ne_zero.mpr hxi)
  
  have hsupport :
      {k : Fin n | y k ≠ 0} = ({i, j} : Set (Fin n)) := by
    ext k
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · subst k
      simp [hyi]
    by_cases hkj : k = j
    · subst k
      simp [hyj]
    simp [y, w, a, b, hki, hkj]
  
  exact ⟨y, hnorm, hyinner, hsupport, hyi, hyj⟩
